name: solo-office
description: OOXML office suite (spreadsheet / document / presentation) implemented independently from ECMA-376; desktop shell on Electron.

scripts.build: rm -rf app && mkdir -p app && esbuild src/ui/renderer.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=app/renderer.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=app/preload.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=app/main.cjs --log-level=warning && cp src/ui/index.html app/index.html
